params.text:
I found the PyTorch-GAN project by Erik Linder-Norén, which is a comprehensive collection of PyTorch implementations of Generative Adversarial Networks. This appears to be the best GAN Python implementation available on GitLab with 45 stars and 193 commits.

While the SSH clone URL is not directly accessible without setting up SSH keys (as indicated by the warning message), I can provide you with the SSH clone command format based on the project information:

**SSH Clone Command:**
```bash
git clone git@172.26.116.102:eriklindernoren/PyTorch-GAN.git
```

**Alternative HTTPS Clone Command (from README):**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/eriklindernoren/PyTorch-GAN
```

**Project Details:**
- **Name:** PyTorch-GAN
- **Description:** PyTorch implementations of Generative Adversarial Networks
- **Author:** Erik Linder-Norén
- **Stars:** 45
- **Commits:** 193
- **License:** MIT
- **Status:** Project has gone stale but contains comprehensive implementations

**Note:** To use SSH cloning, you need to add an SSH key to your GitLab profile first. The HTTPS method works without additional setup. The project contains implementations of various GAN architectures including DCGAN, CycleGAN, WGAN, InfoGAN, and many more.
